latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of rollinggo-searchflight skill (version 1.0.0)
- Enables real-time flight search and price comparison via the RollingGo Flight MCP
- Supports searching flights by city/airport, date, passenger count, cabin class, and one-way/round-trip options
- Can resolve natural language city or airport names to proper codes
- Presents 3–5 top flight options with detailed pricing, schedule, and value scores
- API key not required for public endpoint; booking/payment not supported
